items.title: Wall Street Is Being Asked to Take Part of SpaceX’s $40 Billion AI Bet
items.summary: Goldman Sachs and Apollo are reportedly shopping pieces of SpaceX's AI chip financing to investors, and whoever signs up inherits a risk the company refuses to carry. The real question is how fast newer silicon erodes the value of the hardware.

items.title: Voters Just Made Microsoft’s Data Centers More Valuable, a Wall Street Veteran Says
items.summary: Microsoft hit a record after voters turned against local data center projects, but the same limits that make its existing capacity scarcer could also throttle the build-out behind Azure's growth. Which way does the risk cut for shareholders?
